name: 酷飒英伦风厚底马丁靴款

category.leaf: 英伦风厚底系带马丁靴

description: 酷飒系带马丁靴：厚底显高、侧拉链易穿脱、立体底纹行走舒适

styleLock.backgroundSystem: plush off-white fur #F7F5F2 for hero and scene shots, clean light-grey studio #ECECEC for info and detail shots, white #FFFFFF for spec and trust screens
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft diffused studio light with a gentle front-left key, soft natural shadows, visible grounding contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: plush long-pile fur rug, plain kraft cardboard box, matte light-grey studio floor
styleLock.typography: letter-spaced modern sans-serif headlines, bilingual section headers, thin divider lines
styleLock.presentationRules: stable product scale, boots grounded with contact shadows, hero pair always shown as a matched left-right pair
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool minimal fashion footwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of plush off-white fur #F7F5F2, light studio grey #ECECEC, charcoal text #1C1C1E and one muted gold ribbon accent #C9A96A, with the kraft cardboard box prop in warm brown #C9A876; soft diffused studio lighting with a gentle front-left key and soft natural contact shadows; letter-spaced modern sans-serif headlines with thin divider lines; clean high-end footwear photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale with boots grounded by contact shadows; clean breathing margins around the product; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 开场一秒建立酷飒气质并给出核心卖点，赢得点击
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle looking slightly down from about 30 degrees above, full pair visible, toes pointing outward
shots.lighting: soft diffused studio light from the front left, soft natural shadows on the fur, grounded contact shadow
shots.props: one muted gold satin ribbon #C9A96A draped loosely, not covering the product
shots.textZone: top-center one short headline 「{callout_1}」 in #1C1C1E set on the fur
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce hero shot of {product}, a matched left-right pair shown together on a plush rug. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a slight 3/4 angle looking slightly down from about 30 degrees above, full pair visible, toes pointing outward, the pair filling 60-70% of the frame. Soft diffused studio light from the front left, soft natural shadows and a grounding contact shadow under the boots. Plush off-white long-pile fur surface #F7F5F2 filling the frame, one muted gold satin ribbon #C9A96A draped loosely beside the boots. A short headline 「{callout_1}」 in #1C1C1E is set across the top-center of the fur, clear of the boots. 8K commercial footwear quality. Negative: no brand logo, no readable brand text, no watermark, no props covering the product, no extra text, no cut-off edges, no floating product.

shots.intent: 一眼看到全部配色，让买家自己选
shots.camera: identical straight-on eye-level side view for every variant, arranged in one row
shots.lighting: even soft studio light, identical across all variants, soft contact shadows
shots.textZone: one short color label under each variant 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 in #1C1C1E
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant row of {product} shown in three colorways side by side — one deep black #1C1C1E, one warm brown #6B4A2F, one mid grey #8A8A8A. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Every variant at an identical straight-on eye-level side view with identical lighting and scale, evenly spaced in one row. Even soft studio light, soft contact shadows under each boot. Light studio grey background #ECECEC. One short color label under each variant 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 in #1C1C1E. The row fills 60-70% of the frame overall with matching margins above and below. Negative: no mixed lighting between variants, no texture loss on dark colors, no perspective drift between variants, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no hands.

shots.intent: 用侧视尺寸标注消除靴高跟高疑虑

shots.props: thin dimension callout lines pointing to shaft height, heel height and shaft width
shots.textZone: three dimension labels 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 in #1C1C1E plus one small note line 「{callout_4}」 on measuring tolerance

Three short dimension labels 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 in #1C1C1E tied to their callout lines, plus one small note line 「{callout_4}」 on measuring tolerance beneath the boot.
